verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab explicitly documents standalone headless operation from workstation to data center. Isaac Sim adds Docker containers for repeatable setups, standalone Python scripts, pip-installable packages, and integration into existing testing and validation pipelines or automated workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI-runner documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions or GPU CI setup), a documented headless mode for Isaac Sim itself beyond Isaac Lab, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
